summary: This Phase 3 study tested two different diabetes drugs, HDG1901 and Ozempic, in adults with Type 2 diabetes whose blood sugar was not well controlled by metformin alone. The trial enrolled 494 participants who received weekly injections in the abdomen for 32 weeks. The sponsor of this study is Hangzhou Zhongmei Huadong Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. This study has been marked as Completed.
